step.en: After a batch with at least one success, the system builds an Excel report of all stage changes of the day
step.id: Setelah batch dengan minimal satu sukses, sistem membuat report Excel berisi semua perubahan stage hari itu

detail.en: ChangeOfProcessingService runs the block only when succeeded > 0. It loads cpsRepository.findByDateOfChange(today) (all change records of today, from every officer and batch) and calls reportGenerationService.generateChangeStageReport, which builds an .xlsx (sheet 'Change Processing Stage Report', one retry) and uploads it to blob path reports/change-stage/ChangeStageReport_<yyyyMMdd_HHmmss>_<userId>.xlsx (ReportGenerationService.java:61, 140-185). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-095 (Closed) fixed the current-offender content of this report; it shows the report is used.
detail.id: ChangeOfProcessingService menjalankan blok ini hanya kalau succeeded > 0. Isinya cpsRepository.findByDateOfChange(today) (semua change record hari ini, dari semua officer dan batch) lalu generateChangeStageReport yang membuat .xlsx (sheet 'Change Processing Stage Report', retry sekali) dan upload ke blob path reports/change-stage/ChangeStageReport_<yyyyMMdd_HHmmss>_<userId>.xlsx (ReportGenerationService.java:61, 140-185). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-095 (Closed) memperbaiki isi current offender di report ini; ini menunjukkan report dipakai.

step.en: The batch response returns a download link valid for 24 hours; if report generation fails, the batch still succeeds
step.id: Response batch mengembalikan link download berlaku 24 jam; kalau pembuatan report gagal, batch tetap sukses

detail.en: Failure handling is as stated: the report block is wrapped in try/catch, the exception is only logged ('Don't fail the entire operation') and reportInfo stays null. The 24 hours is not enforced: expiresAt = now + 24h (line 153) is just a field in the response. The 'url' is a plain blob path, not a signed (SAS) link, and the download endpoint (ChangeOfProcessingController.java:422-480) never checks any expiry. Whether the blob is deleted after 24 hours (storage lifecycle policy) cannot be verified from the repo. CPSForm.tsx:298-300 downloads the file automatically right after save using only the file name.
detail.id: Penanganan gagal sesuai: blok report dibungkus try/catch, exception hanya di-log ('Don't fail the entire operation') dan reportInfo tetap null. Masa 24 jam tidak ditegakkan: expiresAt = now + 24h (baris 153) cuma field di response. 'url' adalah blob path biasa, bukan link bertanda tangan (SAS), dan endpoint download (ChangeOfProcessingController.java:422-480) tidak pernah mengecek expiry. Apakah blob dihapus setelah 24 jam (storage lifecycle policy) cannot verify from repo. CPSForm.tsx:298-300 mendownload file otomatis setelah save, hanya pakai nama file.

step.en: POST /v1/change-processing-stage/reports lists the reports for a date range, maximum 90 days
step.id: POST /v1/change-processing-stage/reports menampilkan daftar report untuk rentang tanggal, maksimal 90 hari

detail.en: The endpoint requires startDate and endDate, rejects a range over 90 days (line 302) or an end date before the start date, groups the change records by date and lists the blobs with the prefix reports/change-stage/ChangeStageReport_<yyyyMMdd> from Azure Blob (line 358), paged and sorted by date descending. Behaviour to note: a date only appears if it has change records in the database; reportDate, generatedBy and noticeCount are per date, so two report files on the same date show the same count and users; a date whose blob is gone is still listed with reportUrl null.
detail.id: Endpoint mewajibkan startDate dan endDate, menolak rentang di atas 90 hari (baris 302) atau end date sebelum start date, mengelompokkan change record per tanggal lalu mengambil daftar blob dengan prefix reports/change-stage/ChangeStageReport_<yyyyMMdd> dari Azure Blob (baris 358), dengan paging dan urut tanggal menurun. Yang perlu diperhatikan: tanggal hanya muncul kalau ada change record di database; reportDate, generatedBy dan noticeCount dihitung per tanggal, jadi dua file report di tanggal sama menampilkan count dan user yang sama; tanggal yang blob-nya sudah hilang tetap muncul dengan reportUrl null.

detail.en: The reportId is sanitized (only letters, digits, . _ -), '.xlsx' is added when missing, the file is read from blob path reports/change-stage/<reportId> and returned as an attachment; an unknown id returns 404 REPORT_NOT_FOUND. Both endpoints are mapped to function OCMS_REPORT_CPS in ocmsadminapi/src/main/resources/api-authorization.properties:147-149.
detail.id: reportId disanitasi (hanya huruf, angka, . _ -), '.xlsx' ditambahkan kalau belum ada, file dibaca dari blob path reports/change-stage/<reportId> dan dikirim sebagai attachment; id yang tidak ada mengembalikan 404 REPORT_NOT_FOUND. Kedua endpoint dipetakan ke function OCMS_REPORT_CPS di ocmsadminapi/src/main/resources/api-authorization.properties:147-149.

step.en: The Report page has a CPS tab (function REPORT_CPS) that shows the list and downloads a file
step.id: Halaman Report punya tab CPS (function REPORT_CPS) yang menampilkan daftar dan mendownload file

detail.en: The tab is shown only when hasFunction(FUNCTION_ID.REPORT_CPS) is true (constant OCMS_REPORT_CPS, utils/constant.ts:261). ReportListCPS.tsx:125-128 loads resource change-processing-stage/reports with POST and shows Report Date, Generated By and Notice Count; the Download button calls change-processing-stage/report with the file name (ReportListCPS.tsx:41-52, 164) and there is also a ZIP export of the listed files. The tab title in the UI is 'Change Processing Stage Report' (Report/index.tsx:89), not 'CPS'. Which roles hold REPORT_CPS is configured outside the repo.
detail.id: Tab hanya tampil kalau hasFunction(FUNCTION_ID.REPORT_CPS) true (konstanta OCMS_REPORT_CPS, utils/constant.ts:261). ReportListCPS.tsx:125-128 memuat resource change-processing-stage/reports dengan POST dan menampilkan Report Date, Generated By dan Notice Count; tombol Download memanggil change-processing-stage/report dengan nama file (ReportListCPS.tsx:41-52, 164) dan ada juga export ZIP untuk file di daftar. Judul tab di UI adalah 'Change Processing Stage Report' (Report/index.tsx:89), bukan 'CPS'. Role mana yang punya REPORT_CPS diatur di luar repo.

step.en: If any notice failed or gave a warning, an error e-mail with the batch result is sent asynchronously to email.error.recipients
step.id: Kalau ada notice gagal atau warning, e-mail error berisi hasil batch dikirim secara asynchronous ke email.error.recipients

detail.en: The condition is failed > 0 || warnings > 0. sendErrorNotificationAsync runs on an executor (CompletableFuture.supplyAsync, ChangeProcessingStageNotificationService.java:54-62) and sends an HTML e-mail with subject '[<PROFILE>] OCMS System Error - <n> Failed Notices on <date>' to the value of email.error.recipients (application-prod.properties:49: MGG addresses plus two ura.gov.sg addresses). The e-mail failure is only logged and does not fail the batch. email.enableSmtp is not overridden in the prod properties, so the default true from application.properties:133 applies; actual delivery and the real server value cannot be verified from the repo. The recipients are developer, support and two URA addresses, so this is an internal alert, not a user-facing feature. Review: the mail logic is in code but delivery cannot be proven and the recipients are internal developer addresses (application-prod.properties:49), so it is not counted as a user feature.
detail.id: Kondisinya failed > 0 || warnings > 0. sendErrorNotificationAsync jalan di executor (CompletableFuture.supplyAsync, ChangeProcessingStageNotificationService.java:54-62) dan mengirim e-mail HTML dengan subject '[<PROFILE>] OCMS System Error - <n> Failed Notices on <date>' ke nilai email.error.recipients (application-prod.properties:49: alamat MGG plus dua alamat ura.gov.sg). Kalau e-mail gagal hanya di-log dan batch tidak ikut gagal. email.enableSmtp tidak di-override di prod properties, jadi default true dari application.properties:133 berlaku; pengiriman sebenarnya dan nilai di server asli cannot verify from repo. Penerimanya developer, support dan dua alamat URA, jadi ini alert internal, bukan fitur untuk user. Review: logic e-mail ada di code tetapi pengirimannya tidak bisa dibuktikan dan penerimanya adalah alamat developer internal (application-prod.properties:49), jadi tidak dihitung sebagai fitur untuk user.

note.en: The repo proves all six steps in code, except the 24-hour validity of the link, which is only a response field. Not provable from the repo: blob lifecycle (deletion after 24 hours), real mailbox delivery, which roles hold REPORT_CPS, and whether URA asked for the report (no flow deck; only ticket OCMS-DF-2026-095 shows it is used). The separate PLUS path builds a report of all of today's changes (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1395-1421); it is not claimed. Risk: URA may read the report as part of OCMS15.9/15.10.
note.id: Repo membuktikan keenam step di code, kecuali masa berlaku link 24 jam yang hanya field di response. Tidak bisa dibuktikan dari repo: blob lifecycle (hapus setelah 24 jam), pengiriman ke mailbox asli, role mana yang punya REPORT_CPS, dan apakah URA memang meminta report ini (tidak ada flow deck; hanya ticket OCMS-DF-2026-095 yang menunjukkan report dipakai). Jalur PLUS terpisah membuat report semua perubahan hari ini (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:1395-1421); tidak diklaim. Risiko: URA bisa menganggap report ini bagian dari OCMS15.9/15.10.

corrections: Acceptance 1: 'returns a download link valid 24 hours' is too strong. The response has expiresAt = now + 24h, but the link is a blob path and nothing enforces or checks the 24 hours. Suggest: 'returns the report path and an expiry time of 24 hours'.
Acceptance 3: the tab is not called 'CPS' in the UI; its title is 'Change Processing Stage Report' (path cps_report, function REPORT_CPS).
Acceptance 2 (optional wording): the list is built from change records in the database plus blobs by date prefix, so a date without change records never appears.
